enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Bend knees. Move arm under pillow. Turn onto back. Sigh. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Remain motionless.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Turn off water heater. Walk out of bathroom.

Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever down. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs with fork. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs with spatula. Turn off induction cooker. Remove eggs to plate. Butter toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat toast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip fly. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Turn off fan. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone for time. Put phone in pocket. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Put phone away. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at office on community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Type password. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open document. Type report. Pick up phone. Dial number. Speak on phone. Hang up. Walk to meeting room. Sit at table. Discuss community program. Take notes. Return to desk. Continue typing. Print document. File document.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay cashier. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw trash. Walk outside. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at office on community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Present program plan. Take notes. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Send emails. Edit document. Print flyers. Organize files. Talk to coworker. Update calendar. Shut down computer.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read news. Put phone away. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter house. Close door. Remove shoes.

Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, chicken. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light.

Walk to living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Return to sofa. Eat snack. Continue watching TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Turn off TV. Turn off light.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Type password. Open browser. Check social media. Open email. Read emails. Reply to email. Open document. Type notes. Save file. Close browser. Shut down laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bed. Pull back covers. Lie down. Pull covers up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Turn onto back. Sigh. Turn to left side. Remain motionless.
